description: Verify and lock the quoted rate with the supplier before payment. Returns prebook_id (required for start_booking), current total, cancellation, taxes, and terms_digest. If status is PRICE_CHANGED, show the guest the new terms and call again with accepted_terms_digest set to terms_digest. If the quoted total exceeds a budget the user stated, do NOT call this yet: tell them the price, say it exceeds their budget, and get explicit confirmation first.

accepted_terms_digest.description: Required when repricing after PRICE_CHANGED — must match the latest terms_digest from prebook_stay.

journey_id.description: Continuity handle returned as journey_id in previous Tell & Go tool results. Always pass the most recent journey_id you have received in this conversation.

option_token.description: Exact opaque option token returned by get_quote.

rate_id.description: Exact visible rate id returned by get_quote.

residency.description: Exact two-letter residency echoed by get_quote.

name: prebook_stay

outputSchema.description: Locked supplier terms required by start_booking.

cancellation.description: Locked cancellation terms. A refundable rate also carries processing_fee_percent (5), refund_percent_within_window (95) and refund_note.

change_explanation.description: Why terms changed, when they did.

journey_id.description: Continuity handle. Pass it back as journey_id on the next Tell & Go tool call.

option_token.description: Echo of the option_token; pass to start_booking.

prebook_id.description: pbk_ handle to pass to start_booking.

rate_id.description: Echo of the rate_id; pass to start_booking.

residency.description: Echo of the residency; pass to start_booking.

taxes.description: Taxes included in the total and payable at the property.

terms_digest.description: Digest of the locked terms; echo as accepted_terms_digest after a price change.

title: Lock stay terms before checkout
